action: Respond to Frank Russo's outreach. Call him back directly, set up a coffee meeting this week. Approach it as a peer conversation — two educators with vehicle-related programs watching the same disruption from different angles. Listen first: what is he thinking about doing with the driving school? Is he looking to pivot, collaborate, or just vent? If he's open to it, float the idea that a driving school with AV literacy curriculum could feed into the same Auto Tech Pipeline infrastructure — safety, sensor awareness, human-AV interaction. Don't over-pitch. Make him feel heard. Build the relationship before asking anything of it.
